architecture:
System: Case-Management-136
Primary NIST family: Personnel Security (PS); evidence focus: PS-5.
Environment: Azure Government. Network access uses Private Link; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a customer-managed Key Vault key. Control evidence: position risk designations are documented before privileged responsibilities are assigned. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
